stages.title: Source identity, schematic integrity and ruleset
hard_invariants: do not change pad→net mapping without schematic-approved ECO
real DRC/ERC errors are not PASS
actions: record PCB/SCH/PRO/rulebook SHA and KiCad version
extract netlist, ERC, current DRC where available
classify unclear constraints and gather exact datasheet/fab rules
stages.soft_failure: Continue generating review and candidate plans in an isolated copy, mark NEEDS_EVIDENCE; never certify until resolved

stages.title: Mechanical anchor and movement-envelope planning
hard_invariants: mounting holes, antenna keepout, creepage when specified
actions: fix true mechanical anchors only
retain edge-sliding degrees of freedom for unconstrained connectors
label movable/reserved space by congestion corridor rather than fixed free area
stages.soft_failure: Try alternative legal connector translation/functional-block orientation; retain immutable locked anchors

stages.title: Build electrical-topology dependency graph
hard_invariants: respect functional pin identities and safety domains
actions: map supply-pin/decoupler local loops, input/filter/AFE/ADC chains, ESD-port-PHY, switching hot loops, MOSFET gates, RF matching, differential pair and ground returns
classify net priority from edge rate, energy, noise sensitivity and hardware constraints
select applicable reference patterns by IC/topology/stackup, not simply device names
stages.soft_failure: Unknown nets remain NEEDS_EVIDENCE; optimize independent known blocks while preserving unknown paths

stages.title: Generate multiple board-level candidate placements
actions: generate placement variants by legal rotation, translation and block permutations
cluster support passives around relevant pads using low-loop impedance proxy
reserve critical fanout corridors and local movement slack
reject only invalid candidates, not the entire batch
stages.soft_failure: Keep the best legal candidate and generate locally perturbed alternatives; never declare 'no solution' due to a single failed attempt

stages.title: Electrical-critical local placement and escape precheck
actions: close switch + input bypass current loop using topology-specific copper path
align ESD+USB PHY, clock and RF matching with required reference areas
protect VCAP and high-frequency decoupling path, AFE inputs and precision references
check test access and tight package escape
stages.soft_failure: Adjust only the local functional group, recalculate return path, or choose another candidate; don't push critical parts away just to obtain a short ordinary signal

stages.title: Predict congestion and mark routing corridors
hard_invariants: legal trace clearances and drill/neck rules
actions: build corridor occupancy/crossing/fanout feasibility map using global pad positions and copper geometries
identify movable unrelated blockers such as reset pull-up occupying UART corridor
assess candidate alternate escapes by layer and ground return
rank blockers by critical-net detour cost, not generic visual whitespace
stages.soft_failure: Emit proposed local component shifts, orientation changes or alternative layer topology and retry WF03–WF05

stages.title: Trial-route constrained net groups on clones
hard_invariants: no modifications outside selected scope without explicit diff
no omitted KiCad custom clearance/DRU rules
actions: route clock/critical analog, power hot loops, USB/differential nets and constrained escapes as appropriate
record failed exits, vias, length, return discontinuity and pre/post DRC
if router repeatedly detours, return to WF03/WF04 with culprit move proposals
allow multiple candidate trials under a finite resource budget
stages.soft_failure: Try alternative route order, scoped rip-up and another legal placement; if tools unavailable return an executable plan with honest NOT_RUN status

stages.title: Route full PCB in dependency-aware groups
actions: choose net-group order based on conflicts and criticality rather than alphabetic list
avoid unnecessary vias/detours but allow justified layer transitions with return management
iterate limited rip-up of only newly affected routes
keep best complete feasible candidate and compare per-net deltas
stages.soft_failure: Retry affected group with alternate ordering; widen movement envelope of movable groups; never delete all existing valid routes indiscriminately

stages.title: Power/ground/EMI/DFM spatial review
hard_invariants: known copper current, isolation and thermal requirements
actions: refill copper zones and inspect connectivity/return continuity/islands
evaluate voltage drop and current neckdown, SW/FB separation, shielding and safety
evaluate USB pair impedance only with known PHY/stackup; no fabricated 90-ohm pass
compare if a same-layer detour is worse than justified vias
stages.soft_failure: Propose local copper/placement changes and return to WF04–WF07; log remaining NEEDS_EVIDENCE conditions

stages.title: Native KiCad checks and source consistency
hard_invariants: no newly introduced hard ERC/DRC error for release
actions: run native KiCad ERC and DRC on exact candidate
check fill state, pad-net, width, via, courtyard, copper short, unrouted, diff to baseline
record exceptions and precise locations for automatic repair proposals
stages.soft_failure: No silent bypass: return to earliest cause stage with localized repair recipe; when KiCad unavailable label NOT_RUN and keep candidate unreleased

stages.title: Select Pareto-improving legal candidate and stop bounded search
hard_invariants: baseline and all candidate hashes kept
actions: discard violating candidates but retain learnings
compare on route completion, critical return/loop, critical path length, via count, congestion, user locks and DFM
avoid converting metrics with unknown units or uncalibrated weighted cost into false precision
stop on convergence or fixed iteration budget, retaining best feasible candidate and untested alternatives
stages.soft_failure: Report best known candidate and pending risks with next actionable experiment; NEVER claim global optimum from finite search

stages.title: Produce auditable deliverables and user-controlled upstream proposals
hard_invariants: do not push from Training into LayoutRule main
owner approval required for canonical rule change
actions: save board outputs and before/after metrics with source and rulebook hashes
create evidence-backed rule candidate report with scope, exception and counterexample
classify checks as PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN or NEEDS_EVIDENCE
ask owner to approve exact proposed rules, separately from candidate PCB acceptance
stages.soft_failure: Deliver partial verified artifacts and explicit gaps rather than block all useful reports

stages.title: Learn from real hardware revisions and negative cases
hard_invariants: source revisions and outcome evidence pinned
no unapproved promotion to canonical rules
actions: compare before/after of same-board revisions with changes in netlist, layer count, thermal, return and EMC outcomes
retain failures and unverified cases for future regression tests
update candidate heuristics only with documented counterexamples and owner-controlled promotion
stages.soft_failure: Keep evidence as draft or inconclusive and continue collecting; don't force a rule from incomplete data

resource_budget.notes: Default evaluation budgets are computational heuristics, NOT electrical standards. Caller may tune them. Preserve every change and no unbounded loops.

reject_on: new hard DRC/ERC violations for release
selection_policy.recovery: try legal localized alternatives, retain best prior candidate and actionable report; do not disable constraints
